dimension_evidence.original_dimensions: 15 inch touchscreen; volume specification 15/10 L, 29.5/20 L, 50/35 L; no whole-system W/D/H
dimension_evidence.inference: Photo-scaled single-vessel frame with top motor, angled side HMI and integrated pump column. A 0.20 m inner diameter and about 0.48 m cylindrical length are a volume-consistent visualization, not a manufacturer vessel drawing.
dimension_evidence.uncertainty: 20-25% overall envelope; jacket thickness, vessel internals, HMI aspect ratio, piping and manual valve/service-lid travel uncalibrated. Not counted as completed exact facility model.

notes: One single 15L system is shared by all six matching device IDs. It is not a two-vessel installation.
Top-drive compact frame follows facility photos; six-blade impellers and process plumbing are explanatory estimates.
Manufacturer technical PDF for 7.5/30L is a different configuration; its dimensions are not copied into this asset.
